messages:
Maya Patel: Quick account health check for LumenPay — weekly triage. TL;DR: usage +18% MoM, avg p95 latency ~420ms (+60ms), overall error rate 1.9% (baseline 0.3%). Spike breakdown looks like: 5xx ~62% of errors, timeouts ~25%, rate_limited ~13%. Posting top failing endpoints and suggested actions below.

Jon Chen: Can you drop the endpoint list + counts? Need to know whether it's a single hotspot or spread.

Maya Patel: Sure — pulled from pulse and recent traces (UTC window 2024-10-04T13:30-14:30):
```
1) POST /v1/generate -> 480 errors (5xx) ~48% of total errors. p95 latency 840ms.
2) POST /v1/chat/stream -> 190 errors (timeouts) ~19%. p95 1.2s.
3) POST /v1/embeddings -> 120 errors (rate_limited) ~12%. bursty from a single API key.
4) GET /v1/status/model -> 60 errors (502/503) ~6%.
5) POST /v1/re-rank -> 40 errors (5xx) ~4%.
```

Sam Park: I pulled gateway logs for the same window. Seeing a tight cluster of 502/504 coming from model-proxy replicas between 14:02-14:08 UTC. Sample lines: 
`[2024-10-04T14:03:05Z] model-proxy-2 - upstream 127.0.0.1:9000 -> 502 (connection reset)`
`[2024-10-04T14:05:11Z] model-proxy-1 - timeout waiting for kv-cache flush`
Also noticed repeated client retries from the onboarding client with the header `x-cs-flow: onboarding`. That aligns with the bursts to POST /v1/generate.

Alex Rivera: We did a small prompt-formatting change pushed yesterday afternoon that increased avg token decode time for some flows. Could be why generate p95 jumped and proxies timed out. Also seeing a big increase in concurrent sessions from that onboarding key. Request: can we temporarily raise rate limits for that API key while we mitigate?

Jon Chen: On infra side: autoscaler for model-serving pool shows several scale-up events but replicas joined late (~30-45s) — autoscaler cooldown may be too aggressive for sudden bursts. I'll dig into why model-proxy replicas returned 502s (possible kernel OOM or keepalive exhaustion).

Maya Patel: Customer impact/risk: LumenPay is mid-onboarding (trial -> paid expected next week). This spike affects core UX for the trial flow. Renewal risk if onboarding stalls. Recommend immediate mitigation + a short postmortem and CS notification.

Alex Rivera: Proposed mitigations: 1) rollback prompt change (fast) 2) bump rate limit for onboarding API key by 25% for 2 hours 3) increase model-serving minimum replicas by 1 for the next 3 hours 4) add short-term 10s longer upstream timeout on the proxy to reduce 5xx churn.

Jon Chen: I'll take items 2 and 3 (rate bump + replicas). Need approval from CS for temporary quota increase. Sam, can you run a quick health-check script after we change replicas? Command I used: 
`kubectl get pods -l app=model-proxy -o wide`

Sam Park: Yep — will monitor and post health checks. Also capturing heap/FD stats.

ops-bot: DeployBot: Canary deployment started for model-serving v2.3 at 2024-10-04T14:05:00Z (commit abc123). Status: succeeded on 2/3 canaries, third pod restarted.

Maya Patel: CS approves temporary rate bump for onboarding key. Action items: 
- Jon: increase rate limit + raise min replicas now (ETA 10m)
- Sam: run health-checks and post logs once replicas stabilize
- Alex: prepare rollback plan for prompt change (if latencies don't improve in 30m)
- Maya: notify LumenPay PM that we're investigating and that we applied a temporary quota bump; follow up with EOD summary
- Jon/Alex: schedule a short postmortem tomorrow AM focusing on autoscaler cooldown and prompt change regression

Jon Chen: Starting rate bump + scale change now. Will post status in ~8m.

Sam Park: Health-checks: model-proxy pods back to READY=3/3; p95 for /v1/generate dropped from 840ms -> 460ms in last 5m. Error rate dropping (5xx down ~70%). Posting logs: `tail -n 50 /var/log/model-proxy/proxy.log` shows fewer upstream resets.

Maya Patel: Great. Please leave this thread open — will update with EOD notes + follow-up PM outreach. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
